summary: The Legacy Project at Wesleyan University is a chapter of The Legacy Project, Inc., which connects college students with older adults in their local communities to (1) foster intergenerational friendships and (2) preserve older adults' life histories.

name: The Mazel Tones
categories: Identity, Performance & Visual Arts, Spirituality, Social, Music
summary: The Mazel Tones is Wesleyan's one and only Jewish a capella group. We are an enthusiastic bunch of singers (both Jewish and non-Jewish!) who sing Jewish music in all languages spoken by Jews: Hebrew, English, Yiddish, Ladino and more!

name: The Mixolydians

summary: The Mixolydians are Wesleyan's only chamber choir a cappella group.

name: The Shed
categories: Performance & Visual Arts, Fundraising, Music, Film / Photography
summary: The Shed is dedicated to establishing a place for student artists, especially musicians, to showcase their work on campus through organizing concerts, showcases, and festivals.

name: The Sloth Storytelling Collective
categories: Performance & Visual Arts, Media, Social, Theater
summary: The Sloth is a storytelling collective dedicated to the art of oral storytelling. We put on open mic events, planned events, and events with the larger Middletown community.

name: The Wesleyan Argus
summary: Wesleyan's newspaper.

name: The Wesleyan Doula Project
categories: Activism, Community Service, Volunteer, Social Justice
summary: The Wesleyan Doula Project (WDP) is a student-run collective dedicated to providing free and compassionate support for people making the decision to terminate their pregnancies. By providing emotional, physical, and informational support and advocacy.

name: The Wesleyan Folk Music Collective
summary: The Wesleyan Folk Collective brings Wesleyan's community of folk musicians and folk music-lovers together through open jams, performance opportunities, and dance events, cultivating a space for traditional music styles on campus!

name: The Wesleyan Science Journal
summary: The Wesleyan Science Journal is a student run publication focused on highlighting the scientific news and research of the Wesleyan community.

summary: <https://www.wesleyan.edu/writing/>

name: Threads & Thingamabobs
summary: Threads & Thingamabobs offers a dual environment where experienced artists and beginners can practice embroidery, cross-stitch, crochet, and other threaded arts. We provide a multitude of opportunities for projects of varying lengths and function.

name: Throw Culture
summary: We are Wesleyan's only all-gender ultimate frisbee team! All skill levels are welcome :)

name: Traverse Square Afterschool Program
summary: We are a student-run afterschool program serving the students living in the Traverse Square public housing community.

name: Triple Major A Cappella
summary: We are Wesleyan's only competition a cappella group. We seek out all types of identities and voices, and since Fall 2017 we have competed each year in the International Championship of Collegiate A Cappella.

name: Troupe
summary: Troupe is a hip-hop dance collective dedicated to being a welcoming space for dancers to explore different  styles of hip-hop and performance.

name: Unique Collections (Wesleyan Library)
summary: Unique Collections at Wesleyan Library fosters teaching, learning, and research in the Wesleyan community through the exploration of unique materials, objects, and archival resources.

name: United Student Labor Action Coalition
categories: Activism, Community Service, Social Justice, Politics
summary: USLAC is a group of students organizing around labor issues on campus and in the community. We stand up for workers' rights!

name: University Communications
summary: <https://www.wesleyan.edu/communications/>

name: Uproar Collective
summary: We are a student-run collective providing a space and network for equal gender representation in music. We regularly host events -- from concerts to workshops -- to empower creatives (traditionally with underrepresented genders) in Wesleyan's music scene

name: Upward Bound Math and Science
summary: <https://www.wesleyan.edu/ubms/>

name: Usdan Operations
summary: <https://www.wesleyan.edu/usdan/>

name: Vicious Circles
summary: Wesleyan's gender-diverse ultimate frisbee team competing in the D-III "Women's Division." 2025 National Champions.

name: Vietnamese Student Association
summary: Promoting Vietnamese culture and creating connections amongst Vietnamese, Vietnamese-Americans, and anybody else interested in learning more about our country are the goals of the Vietnamese Students Association.

name: Weightlifting and Fitness Awareness Club
summary: We aim to encourage physical activity and nutritional education to everybody, and every body, using workout plans made by the administrators to serve everybody's needs, and having weekly/biweekly meetings discussing training progress.

name: Wes And
summary: Wes And is Wesleyan's only short-form improv group!

name: Wes Arabesque
summary: Wes Arabesque is an all-inclusive ballet club that teaches all levels of experience through weekly open classes and produces a cohesive full-length ballet production a semester, creating a supportive and non-judgemental dance space for all.

name: Wes Latin & Ballroom
summary: We have student-led Latin & Ballroom dance lessons and a performance team. Our goal is to cultivate a safe and enjoyable environment for students on campus to learn a variety of Latin techniques, regardless of their experience and commitment availability

name: Wes Sangha
summary: Wesleyan's Buddhist meditation student group

name: Wesabi Anime and Gaming Club
summary: Wesabi is Wesleyan's Gaming club.

name: WesAbilities
summary: Wesleyan's disability and accessibility focused student group. We work to build community, advocate, and educate for our members and the wider Wesleyan community.

name: WesBurlesque
summary: WesBurlesque is an annual dance show held each spring. It features about 15 student-choreographed dances, a live band, and vocalists. Show proceeds go to local organizations (e.g. Planned Parenthood, Middletown Mutual Aid), usually totaling $4,500.

name: WesClimb
summary: Open to climbers of all skill levels, WesClimb exists to provide affordable access to rock climbing for all Wesleyan students. Practices at a climbing gym are facilitated multiple times per week and outdoor trips to local crags when the weather is nice.

name: WesEdge
summary: WesEdge is a recreational figure skating club welcome to both new and experienced skaters.

name: WesEMT
summary: Want to learn how to save a life? Take Wesleyan's Emergency Medical Technician Course which will certify you as a nationally recognized EMT.

name: WesEngineering
summary: We work on multi-student collaborative engineering projects such as electric GoKarts, battlebots, and switchadapted toys. The club is an opportunity for students interested in all forms of engineering to work on more rigorous and ambitious projects.

name: Wesleyan Admissions
summary: <https://www.wesleyan.edu/admission/>

name: Wesleyan Adopted Student Alliance
summary: WASA aims to support and enable adopted Wesleyan students through community events such as food outings, movie nights, support groups, and community outreach. We also hope to get involved in the art scene and collaborate with other affinity groups.

name: Wesleyan Book Club
summary: Wesleyan Book Club's mission is to create a reading community at Wesleyan and in Middletown. We meet monthly to discuss books chosen by club members, plan events and organize activities to promote reading.

name: Wesleyan Business Review
summary: It’s time that Wesleyan has a platform in which we hear directly from our peers about their views on current affairs going on in the economy. Join our staff of writers, editors, and graphic designers today!

name: Wesleyan Chamber Music Collective
summary: The Wesleyan Chamber Music Collective brings musicians together to rehearse and perform chamber works, creating a collaborative space for classical music. As Wesleyan’s only student-run chamber group, we offer a unique ensemble experience.

name: Wesleyan Cheerleading
summary: The Wesleyan Cheer team is a co-ed squad that shares school pride and enthusiasm for the sport of cheerleading. No experience is required to join. We perform at football and basketball games, to encourage school spirit throughout the Wesleyan community.

name: Wesleyan Christian Fellowship
summary: Wesleyan Christian Fellowship (WesCF) is connected to and supported by a larger nondenominational organization called InterVarsity Christian Fellowship/USA. Our mission is: "Love God, Cherish Others, Share Christ, Build Community."

name: Wesleyan Clay Club
summary: Clay Club is a ceramics group that brings together people of all experience levels who want to have fun sculpting or throwing some clay on a wheel. We organize weekly studio sessions at Wesleyan Potters in Middletown, just a few minutes from campus.

name: Wesleyan Club Hockey
summary: Wesleyan Club Hockey is a chance for all students to get together and play ice-hockey at Spurrier-Snyder rink. There is always a mix of ages and skill levels and a great, safe, inclusive environment.

name: Wesleyan Club Soccer
summary: A soccer team intended to be a space for women and non-binary people to gather and play soccer in both practice and game settings. We hold 2-3 open practices a week, and play games against other CT schools on weekends in the fall and spring.

name: Wesleyan Club Tennis
summary: Wesleyan Club Tennis is a team of advanced players that competes against other schools across New England at the sub-varsity level.

name: Wesleyan Club Volleyball
summary: Welcome!! Whether you played all throughout high school or you're brand new to volleyball, our club has a space for you in either our recreational league or our competitive team!

name: Wesleyan Co-Ed Water Polo
summary: Wesleyan Co-Ed Water Polo Team is a co-ed club sports team. We practice 3 days a week during fall and spring and compete in the Colonial Division against Amherst, Williams, Middlebury, Coast Guard Academy, WPI, and UMass Amherst.

name: Wesleyan Debate Society
categories: Performance & Visual Arts, Social Justice, Social, Academic, Career, Politics
summary: Wesleyan's Debate Team that competes within the American Parliamentary Debate Association (APDA).

name: Wesleyan Democrats
summary: Campus chapter of the College Democrats of America and College Democrats of Connecticut.

name: Wesleyan Equestrian Team
summary: The Wesleyan Equestrian team is a club team that rides at Whispering Willow Equestrian Center (Durham, CT) and competes in IHSA Zone 1 Region 5. We welcome riders of all experience levels from complete beginners to those who have been riding for years!

name: Wesleyan Ethics Bowl
summary: The Wesleyan Ethics Bowl is a group working to encourage discourse concerning contemporary philosophical and ethical issues through the Intercollegiate Ethics Bowl competition.

name: Wesleyan Events & Conferences
summary: <https://www.wesleyan.edu/eventsandconferences/>

name: Wesleyan Film Board
summary: We are a group of students in charge of programming and screening the Wesleyan Film Series, which screens films 3-4 nights a week at the Goldsmith Family Cinema.

name: Wesleyan Habitat for Humanity
categories: Activism, Community Service, Fundraising, Volunteer, Social Justice
summary: Wes Habitat for Humanity partners with Middlesex HFH to work toward equitable housing access. Club members have the option to volunteer on Tuesdays and Saturdays at the Restore in Cromwell while occasionally participating in local builds.

name: Wesleyan Human Rights Policy Review
categories: Activism, Independent Projects, Publications, Media, Social Justice, Academic, Career, Politics
summary: Wesleyan's Human Rights Policy Review is a digitally and physically printed magazine that is published and distributed spring semester. HRPR encompasses student reviews on legislation and policy that affects human rights crises both past and present.

name: Wesleyan Investments Office
summary: The Wesleyan Investments Office is charged with the day to day management of the Wesleyan endowment. The primary objective of the endowment is to provide enduring support for the academic mission of the University.

name: Wesleyan Jewelry Making Club
summary: Ten members spend six Fridays at the local jewelry-making studio, Wesleyan Potters, taking a group class with a private instructor. Open to all levels, we learn to bend, stamp, saw, solder, and more.

name: Wesleyan Jewish Community
summary: The Wesleyan Jewish Community (WJC) is a pluralistic, student-led Jewish organization. The WJC holds ritual and social gatherings to build community and the world we want to live in. We love singing, praying, and eating. Join us!

name: Wesleyan Karaoke
summary: Wesleyan Karaoke provides students a comfortable, nonjudgemental place to freely express themselves through music. Through karaoke and sing-along-style events, anyone is open to attend and have fun!

name: Wesleyan Local Co-op
categories: Community Service, Volunteer, Social Justice, Social
summary: Wesleyan's Local Co-op (or Co-op) is a student-led, volunteer-run food cooperative that provides local and organic food to the Co-op campus community. Our goal is to provide a healthy and delicious alternative to dining hall food.

name: Wesleyan Marketing Club
categories: Independent Projects, Performance & Visual Arts, Media, Academic, Career
summary: The Wesleyan Marketing Group aims to expose students to terms, skills, and concepts highly utilized in the marketing industry through professional development, networking events and peer project collaboration.

name: Wesleyan Math Club
summary: The Wesleyan Math Club creates a welcoming space for students to explore math outside the classroom. We host meetings and events that make math social, collaborative, and fun.

name: Wesleyan Mock Trial
categories: Performance & Visual Arts, Academic, Career, Politics
summary: An organization that prepares for and participates in mock trials in competition with teams from other schools under the guidelines of the American Mock Trial Association.

name: Wesleyan Multilingual Community Tutors Program
categories: Community Service, Volunteer, Social, Academic, Career
summary: WesMCT, formerly known as WELLP, is a student collective that supports multilingual learners of various ages in their English proficiency through in-person/virtual classroom instruction and tutoring in Middletown.

name: Wesleyan Neuroscience and Arts Club
categories: Independent Projects, Community Service, Performance & Visual Arts, Volunteer, Social, Music, Dance, Academic
summary: We integrate science with visual & performing arts to explore how arts can change the brain, body, & behavior. The club believes that art can serve as a tool for neuroplasticity, particularly with individuals with neurodegenerative disorders.

name: Wesleyan Optical Society
summary: The Wesleyan Optical Society explores optics and photonics through workshops, lectures, and networking. Open to all, we provide hands-on learning, research, and networking opportunities in optical sciences. Join us to learn, innovate, and connect!

name: Wesleyan Outing Club
summary: The Wesleyan Outing Club is a student run group, started in 1937. The Club's headquarters are located at Outhouse, 132 High St. The Club offers a wide range of trips most weekends such as biking, hiking, canoeing, and rock climbing.

name: Wesleyan Period Coalition
summary: WPC aims to promote menstrual justice on campus and in the broader Middletown community through hosting educational events, distributing educational materials, and facilitating support spaces for menstruators.

name: Wesleyan Pre-Dental Society
summary: Together we will work together to make you the strongest applicant for dental school we can! We will hold events to hone your dexterity, volunteer with local practices in the area, and educate the Wesleyan and Middletown communities on good oral health.

name: Wesleyan QuestBridge Chapter
categories: Identity, Community Service, Honor Society, Volunteer, Academic
summary: WesQBC is a tributary of WesQSN and has been around since 2009 and this will be the first time that it has become an approved club at Wesleyan University.

name: Wesleyan Refugee Project
categories: Activism, Community Service, Fundraising, Volunteer, Social Justice, Social, Academic, Politics
summary: The Wesleyan Refugee Project is a committed group of students that works with a variety of international and local community partners to provide services for displaced persons as well as to cultivate a greater understanding of global displacement.

name: Wesleyan Reproductive Advocacy & Legislation
categories: Activism, Community Service, Volunteer, Social Justice, Politics
summary: Reproductive justice is the freedom to have children, not have children, and to raise children in safe & healthy environment. WRAL works on projects surrounding these issues in the Wesleyan community and beyond.

name: Wesleyan Science Education Club
summary: WSEC aims to bring hands-on, engaging, scientific lesson plans to the broader Middletown community. We focus on teaching Wesleyan undergraduates to create and teach science lesson plans to three nearby elementary schools.

name: Wesleyan Ski and Snowboard Team
summary: Wesleyan Ski and Snowboard is home to Wesleyan University's community of skiers and snowboarders. We welcome all levels of snow sports enthusiasts to join us in weekly training sessions, along with slalom, giant slalom, and freestyle competitions.

name: Wesleyan Sound Cooperative
categories: Identity, Community Service, Performance & Visual Arts, Media, Social Justice, Social, Music, Theater, Dance, Career
summary: The Wesleyan Sound Co-op provides live sound equipment and trained technicians for a variety of campus events. Please visit our website to request services and review our policies: <https://sites.google.com/view/wesleyan-wsc/home>

name: Wesleyan Sports Business Club
summary: We're a group of students passionate about working in the sports business space, whether that be through a sports agency, management of a team, coaching, or something else in the sports world! We meet weekly for networking sessions and guest speakers.

name: Wesleyan Student Assembly
summary: Founded in 1903, the Wesleyan Student Assembly (WSA) is the undergraduate student government association at Wesleyan University.

name: Wesleyan Student of Color Pre-Law Association
summary: The purpose of the Wesleyan Student of Color Pre-Law Association is to increase student access and opportunity in the field of law by creating a network of alumni-student mentorship, conference opportunities, LSAT prep support, and more.

name: Wesleyan Student Veterans of America
categories: Activism, Identity, Community Service, Performance & Visual Arts, Volunteer, Social
summary: Our organization is dedicated to providing better access to local resources, other student and professional organizations, leadership opportunities, networking, and community building.

name: Wesleyan Students for Justice in Palestine
summary: Wesleyan Students for Justice in Palestine (WesSJP) catalyzes conversations and actions in support of Palestinian resistance and self-determination. We serve as a conduit for education, solidarity, and mobilization on campus and in Middletown.

name: Wesleyan Students in Research
summary: WesSiR is dedicated to providing students the opportunity to find, share, and discuss research that they’ve engaged in. We enrich a space to build community, highlight students’ voices, and facilitate connections between student researchers at Wesleyan.

name: Wesleyan Surf Team
categories: Community Service, Club Sports, Social, Music
summary: The Wesleyan Surf Team is an all inclusive student group that hopes to spread and make available the passion and stoke for surfing to the rest of Wesleyan. The team will meet 1 to 2 times per week and on most weekends year round.

name: Wesleyan Table Tennis
summary: Wesleyan Table Tennis is Wesleyan's only table tennis club. Players of all abilities can come and enjoy the fast-paced, beautiful game that is table tennis. Whether you are looking to learn about the game, play competitively, or just hit with friends.

name: Wesleyan University Library
summary: The Wesleyan University Library fosters teaching, learning, and research by engaging with the Wesleyan community in the discovery and exploration of information and knowledge creation.

name: Wesleyan University Middle School Tutoring Partnership
summary: Wesleyan University Middle School Tutoring Partnership (WUMSTP) serves middle school students who are failing subjects, at risk of retention, and/or in need of general and academic support.

name: Wesleyan University Press
summary: <http://www.wesleyan.edu/wespress>

name: Wesleyan University Sailing Team
summary: The WESLEYAN SAILING TEAM is Wesleyan's competitive intercollegiate sailing team. We compete at regattas around the northeast and the nation, yet as a club team we welcome sailors of any experience and are happy to teach sailing to those new to the sport

name: Wesleyan Women in Science
summary: Wesleyan Women in Science aims to build a sense of community among women and gender minorities in the science, technology, engineering, and math (STEM) fields. While we champion the inclusion of women and gender minorities, we are open to all.

name: Wesleyan Women's Club Basketball
summary: This club is for a dedicated group of students who love playing basketball and want to continue to compete and develop their game in a structured setting. We hold weekly practices and scrimmages.

name: Wesleyan Women's Rugby Club
summary: WesRugby functions under the jurisdiction of USA Rugby and the New England Rugby Football Union. We practice Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday from 4:30 to 6:30 and compete year-round.

name: Wesleyan's Notably Sharp
summary: We are Wesleyan's best dressed a cappella group. We are open to people of all genders and strive to be inclusive, open and respectful as we make music together.

name: Wesleying
summary: A blog

name: WesMalai
summary: WesMalai is Wesleyan's South Asian dance group open to all students, celebrating diverse South Asian dance styles including Bollywood, classical, and hip-hop fusion. We perform vibrant choreographies, with a goal of building culture and community.

name: WesPhoto
summary: We host photo exhibitions and galleries in addition to publishing in our end-of-semester magazine.

name: WesPride
summary: WesPride aims to provide a safe community to build affinity with other queer students on campus. We will hold membership meetings every two weeks and monthly social events.

name: WesQuisqueya
summary: WesQuisqueya is a space for Dominican students of all races, genders, and any other intersection of identity on Wesleyan’s campus to find and cultivate a community with each other.

name: WesReads/WesMath
summary: WesReads/WesMath is a tutoring program that works with students in local elementary schools. Wesleyan students can either work as small group tutors or in-class assistants in Kindergarten through fifth grade classrooms.

name: WESU-FM
summary: WESU Middletown, 88.1 FM is Wesleyan's radio station featuring student DJs as well as DJs from the surrounding Middletown community. WESU is a free-form station with diverse music and public affairs programming.

name: WesWell
summary: WesWell understands the impact of student health on academic performance and is committed to providing services that are designed to develop healthy behaviors and prevent health concerns that may interfere with academic and personal success.

name: Women's Club Water Polo
summary: We are Wesleyan's first women's club water polo team dedicated to increasing the presence and proliferation of the sport among female identifying students on campus. We are running beginner's workshops and fielding a team.

name: Womxn of Color Collective
categories: Activism, Identity, Societies, Program House, Volunteer, Social Justice, Social, Career
summary: The Womxn of Color Collective provides a safe space for all who are in support of issues regarding womxn of color. The Collective comes together to create a safe space for sharing ideas, gaining support, laughing, and having difficult conversations.

name: Working for Intelligent Landscape Design at Wesleyan University
summary: We aim to redefine the way campus could look, moving past the notion of manicured lawns We are working toward a campus full of interesting, productive, and sustainable landscapes. We maintain a permaculture garden outside Westco and Butterfields!

name: X-Tacy The Collective
summary: X-Tacy is a dance team for students who are passionate about and/or interested in hip-hop dance and choreography to bring their talents and creativity forward in a space that encourages and celebrates diversity, sensuality and sexuality.
